title: Need read access to customer_risk tables and scoring UDF in Databricks
description: Our team is building a new churn feature set and needs to read data from the Unity Catalog schema 'credit_risk.curated'. Please grant SELECT on the table 'customer_risk_scores' and EXECUTE on the SQL function 'mask_pan'. Access is required in the UAT workspace only. The grant should be given to our AD group, not to individuals.
business_justification: Feature engineering for the Q4 churn model. Read-only access; no writes required.
